application_type_full: Prior Approval: Change of use - offices to dwellinghouses
description: Prior approval for change of use of Block B Vista Business Centre from office to residential to provide 74 flats with associated cycle storage, refuse storage and amenity spaces.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Three year time limit
The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in this application and the plans submitted:
02-PD200 Rev A; Planning Statement (unnumbered); Environmental Noise Survey (Ref: 17452A-1; Dated: 21/05/2021); Phase I Environmental Report (Ref: CRM.1904.001.GE. R.001.A; Dated: May 2021); Air Quality Assessment (Ref: AQ0940; Dated: May 2021); Statutory Declaration by Monarch Commercial Limited (undated); Exhibit 6 - Collection of business rates (undated); Unnumbered Photograph Sheets - All received: 28/07/2021
02-PD002 Rev A; 02-PD110 Rev D; Value Two Tier Bike Rack (Bike Dock Solutions; undated) - received: 16/09/2021
Transport Statement (Ref: NM/JN/AT/ITL17072-002b; Dated: 17/09/2021) - received: 17/09/2021
02-PD110 Rev E - received 21/09/2021
02-PD007; 02-PD008; 02-PD013 Rev E - received 22/09/2021

Condition : 3 - Prior to the commencement of development, including any demolition works:
A.	Details of an intrusive site investigation are required in addition to the phase 1 desk study previously submitted. These details shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The site shall be investigated by a competent person to identify the extent and nature of contamination. The report should include a tiered risk assessment of the contamination based on the proposed end use of the site. Additional investigation may be required where it is deemed necessary.
B.	If required, a scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority, for written approval. The scheme shall account for any comments made by the Local Planning Authority before the development hereby permitted is first occupied.
During the course of the development:
C.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.
Before the development is first brought into use:
D.	The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 4 - Prior to occupation of any part of the development hereby approved, a Car Park Management Plan for the whole site, including allocation, and control, of spaces for both residential and office use, as well as proposals to prevent on-street parking and measures to avoid residents using the office bays or office workers using the resident's bays, shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The plan shall also include details of the operation of the access gate. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details which shall be permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 5 - No occupation of the development hereby approved shall take place until the applicant has entered into a formal agreement with the Council to provide a contribution towards a Controlled Parking Zone consultation exercise and to the implementation of a Controlled Parking Zone. The agreement shall restrict future occupiers of the proposed development from obtaining a permit, with the exception of persons with disabilities.

Condition : 6 - Prior to occupation, details of a sound mitigation scheme designed to protect the future occupants of the proposed development from noise emitted from aircraft and nearby sources shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing.
Such a scheme shall include details of fenestration, window and door specifications and openings, the ventilation systems, insulation and materials and demonstrate that noise levels within dwellings comply with the requirements of BS 8233:2014 and achieve 35 dB LAeq,16hours within living rooms during the daytime (07:00-23:00), 30 dB LAeq,8 hour within bedrooms at night-time (23:00-07:00) and 45 dB LAmax no more than 15 times per night within bedrooms against up to date noise measurements.
The works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details before the dwellings are occupied and retained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 7 - Prior to occupation, details of the arrangements and management for the storage of residential refuse and recycling including a detailed plan of the residential waste stores, details of how waste collectors will access the waste and the frequency of collection shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The details shall include swept path analysis to demonstrate that a refuse vehicle can access the bin store(s).
The works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details before the dwellings are occupied and retained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 8 - All parking spaces, including the identified blue badge car parking spaces, active Electric Vehicle Charging Points (EVCP) and passive charging provision, shall be laid out in accordance with the approved plans. Prior to occupation full details of the Electric Vehicle Charging Points, each capable of a minimum output of 7.2kW, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include manufacturer's specifications. 
The charging points shall be installed in accordance with the approved details and so maintained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 9 - Prior to occupation of any part of the development hereby approved, details of the proposed planters located within the car parking area, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details which shall be permanently retained thereafter.
